bootstrap.method: paired nonparametric training-seed bootstrap; one shared three-index resample refits all 36 eta curves, independently repeats the registered eight-cell F1/F2/F3 LOO selection for both momentum arms, refits each selected surface, and recomputes all held-out errors

gate.name: G6
gate.success_rule: PASS iff each momentum arm independently has absolute held-out log2-D prediction error <=0.2 on at least 3 of 4 cells

note_line: G6 SURFACE VERDICT: PASS raw=4/4 corrected=3/4

model_selection.criterion: minimum eight-fold leave-one-out RMSE in log2(D) bits
model_selection.tie_break_rule: among candidates within 1e-12 bits of the minimum LOO RMSE, choose the first of F1,F2,F3
